correctness.rationale: Complete proof: every length-eight factor has a 0000 or 11 marker fixing its 5-block phase. Left- and right-special factors can start/end only at offsets 3/0; every long bispecial is 01 beta(u) 0 with exactly the bilateral extension pairs of u. All length<=7 contexts are completely enumerated from seven length-three source factors, giving bilateral order +1 at empty and 0, -1 at 000 and 101, +1 at 010; all other orders zero. The elementary double-difference identity, recurrence, and interval summation yield the exact p(n). Monotonic high/low interval ratios yield exact liminf/limsup. Standalone standard-library script checks marker, base and p(n) up to 260 and selected larger bilateral profiles; these finite checks are supportive, not replacements for proof.

value.rationale: The invariant is a standard central measure of structural complexity of a newly constructed rich additive-five-power-free automatic sequence. The complete exact formula is a motivated quantitative companion to its avoidance construction and exposes nonconvergent linear growth with two distinct exact rational slopes, a structural phenomenon not inferred merely from its richness or power-freeness. No unrelated arbitrary parameter slice is introduced.
